name: Buglia
description: Buglia is a small castletown on a island in the middle of the lake dividing the continent sorruonded by 4 of the major countries, it is known as a peaceful trade hub, where you can get goods from all over the world.
The town is independent, but has strong ties to Eldoria, and has their own militia to defend against bandits and other threats.
The town is ruled by by a council of the most prominent merchants on the island, who work together to ensure the town's prosperity.
The town is also known as the Castle town of Buglia

The town is also known for being the main base of operations for the Merchants Guild, which has a branch in the town, which ensures fairness for all merchants through cooperation with the Adventurers Guild, and the Auction House
The town is also known for its annual hunting festival, which attracts hunters from all over .
history: Founded over 300 years ago by settlers from Eldoria.
Recently rebuilt the town square after a fire.
current_events: A band of thieves has been spotted near the northern road.
Preparations for the harvest festival are underway.

notable_figures.name: Mayor Lira
notable_figures.description: Known for her fairness and love of festivals.

notable_figures.name: Old Man Garrick
notable_figures.description: Keeps the town's oral history alive.

rumors: Some say the old mill is haunted.
A merchant claims to have seen a dragon in the hills.
clan_activity: The Silver Blades have opened a new outpost in Buglia.
